item.title: gardener/gardener-extension-envoy-gateway - unnamed-release
item.description:
[github.com/gardener/gardener-extension-envoy-gateway:v0.2.0]

✨ New Features

  • [USER] Fix the EnvoyProxy confused-deputy escalation by switching to GatewayNamespace deploy mode. Add a NetworkPolicy controller, enabled via manageDataPlaneNetworkPolicies, that reconciles the client → proxy ingress and the proxy's DNS + control-plane egress NetworkPolicies for the data-plane proxies. by @DockToFuture [#37]
  • [USER] Generate random HMAC key. by @DockToFuture [#51]
  • [DEVELOPER] PLATFORM in the Makefile now defaults to the host architecture by @anluerz [#53]

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • [USER] The envoy-gateway extension no longer blocks shoot deletion when user Gateway objects were not removed first; it now clears the leftover GatewayClass finalizer during teardown. by @DockToFuture [#39]
  • [USER] Open port 10443/TCP in the Envoy proxy NetworkPolicy so HTTPS Gateways are no longer silently blocked. by @DockToFuture [#40]
  • [DEVELOPER] Fix incorrect YAML path for admission image in update-version-tags and deploy-dev-setup.sh. by @anluerz [#52]

  • (transfer) Stream local blobs and OCI artifacts with fused transformers (#3991)
  • (ci) Scan images for vulnerabilities with govulncheck-derived OpenVEX (#3977)

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • (oci) Re-check blob cache inside singleflight to avoid duplicate fetches (#3941)
  • (transfer) [breaking] Restore resource digest calculation during transfer (revert #3921) (#3987)
  • (wget) Keep client configuration when applying mTLS credentials (#3938)
  • (blob) Truncate download targets and remove rejected content (#3986)
  • (ctf) List component versions with upper-case letters (#3996)
  • (oci) Skip upload of local blobs already present in target (#3998)
  • (transfer) Upload legacy OCI artifact sets (#4037) (#4041)

📦 Dependencies

  • (deps) Update github.com/power-devops/perfstat digest to 22a1a46 (#3944)
  • (deps) Update github.com/digitorus/timestamp digest to b4b58b9 (#3946)
  • (deps) Update github.com/opencontainers/go-digest digest to 63db542 (#3943)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/fxamacker/cbor/v2 to v2.9.4 (#3947)

  • (deps) Update module github.com/onsi/ginkgo/v2 to v2.33.0 (#3956)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/google/go-github/v91 to v92 (fxi #3957) (#3964)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/docker/cli to v29.8.1+incompatible (#3952)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/onsi/gomega to v1.43.1 (#3953)
  • (deps) Update ocm cosign (#3967)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/aws/smithy-go to v1.28.2 (#3951)
  • (deps) Bump go to 1.27.3 (#3973)

  • (deps) Bump golang.org/x/net to v0.61.0 (#3975)
  • (deps) Update ocm cosign (#3995)

⚡ Performance

  • (dag) Process graph nodes with a bounded worker pool (#3997)
  • (oci) Read legacy artifact sets as OCI layouts without conversion (#4044) (#4069)

⚙️ Miscellaneous Tasks

  • Fix the cycle detection blocking on channel wait (#3920)

📚 Documentation

  • (cli) Drop nonexistent --verify-digest-consistency from sign help (#3969)

Get This Release

Install the OCM CLI

``bash
curl -sfL https://ocm.software/install-cli.sh | OCM_VERSION=0.22.0-rc.2 bash
`

For alternative installation options, see the installation guide.

You can also run the OCM CLI in a container without installing it:

`bash
docker run --rm -t ghcr.io/open-component-model/cli:0.22.0-rc.2 --help
`

See the container image guide for more details.

Deploy the OCM Controller

Install into a Kubernetes cluster via Helm:

`bash
helm install ocm-k8s-toolkit oci://ghcr.io/open-component-model/kubernetes/controller/chart \
--version 0.22.0-rc.2 \
--namespace ocm-k8s-toolkit-system \
--create-namespace
`

See the controller setup guide for full configuration options.

OCM Component Distribution (for existing OCM users)

Every OCM release is published as OCM component versions to ghcr.io/open-component-model - the same distribution mechanism OCM enables for your own software. Components in this release:

| Component | Contents |
|---|---|
| ocm.software/ocm:0.22.0-rc.2 | Product wrapper referencing CLI + controller |
| ocm.software/cli:0.22.0-rc.2 | CLI binaries and OCI image |
| ocm.software/kubernetes/controller:0.22.0-rc.2 | Controller image and Helm chart |

Inspect the full product component:

`bash
ocm get component-version ghcr.io/open-component-model//ocm.software/ocm:0.22.0-rc.2 -o yaml
`

Download a CLI binary directly via OCM (requires OCM CLI already installed; replace os and architecture as needed — e.g. linux/amd64, darwin/arm64):

`bash
ocm download resource ghcr.io/open-component-model//ocm.software/cli:0.22.0-rc.2 \
--identity os=linux,architecture=amd64
``

item.title: open-resource-discovery/metadata-renderer - v1.1.2
item.description:
What's new?

Fixed

  • Pinned @scalar/api-reference-react, @scalar/react-renderer, and @scalar/types
to exact versions. Scalar's layout grid and search modal use Vue scoped styles (hash-coupled CSS↔JS); because the lib inlines Scalar's CSS but externalizes its JS, a caret range let consumers resolve a different Scalar version, breaking the OpenAPI layout (stacked, full-width sidebar) and the search modal. Exact pins keep the inlined CSS and the consumer-resolved JS on the same version.

Changed

  • Upgraded @open-resource-discovery/a2a-editor to ^0.4.7 and
@open-resource-discovery/mcp-server-card-ui to ^0.2.4, which confine the ui-components .ord-ui preflight reset to their card roots — the bundled dist/index.css no longer leaks that reset onto a host app's own .ord-ui elements.

------

What's Changed

  • Fix css leak on the consumer sites and scalar search field bug by @aneta-a in #127
  • Lock file maintenance in #126
  • Update dependency vite to v8.3.5 in #124
  • Update dependency @scalar/react-renderer to v0.4.5 in #122
  • Update open-resource-discovery/github-release digest to 97c1b92 in #123
  • Update dependency @scalar/types to ^0.25.0 in #125
Full Changelog: rel/1.1.1...rel/1.1.2

item.title: gardener/gardener-extension-shoot-dns-service - v1.95.0
item.description:
[github.com/gardener/gardener-extension-shoot-dns-service:v1.95.0]

🏃 Others

  • [OPERATOR] Scope per-shoot dnsentries RBAC to its namespace by @MartinWeindel [#857]
  • [OPERATOR] Return nil SecretRef when external DNSRecord is absent by @MartinWeindel [#858]
  • [OPERATOR] Add support for disabling DNS provider types by @MartinWeindel [#865]
  • [USER] Adds the optional dnsProviderReplication.namespaceRestrictionEnabled field to the DNSConfig. When enabled, replicated DNSProviders are restricted to their own namespace, enabling multi-tenant single-cluster setups via the external-dns-management next-generation controller.
Only effective when the next-generation controller is used and replication is enabled; ignored otherwise by @MartinWeindel [#853]

[github.com/gardener/external-dns-management:v0.54.0]

⚠️ Breaking Changes

  • [OPERATOR] aws-route53 providers can only use AWS_USE_CREDENTIALS_CHAIN when the operator has enabled it via the environment variable ALLOW_AWS_CREDENTIALS_CHAIN=true on the dns-controller-manager. Otherwise the provider is rejected during validation. This is typically only relevant for stand alone deployments. by @MartinWeindel [#1155]
  • [USER] DNSEntries with spec.reference set is not supported anymore. It now fails reconciliation instead of inheriting attributes from the referenced entry. by @MartinWeindel [#1162]

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • [OPERATOR] [aws-route53] validate properties even when providerConfig is present. by @MartinWeindel [#1174]
  • [OPERATOR] [next-generation] Release DNS accounts on provider delete and credential rotation. by @MartinWeindel [#1171]
  • [OPERATOR] [next-generation] fix: nil-guard SecretRef in Secret watch map func of source controller by @MartinWeindel [#1161]
  • [OPERATOR] [next-generation] fix(dnsentry): normalize DNS name case before suffix matching by @MartinWeindel [#1163]
  • [OPERATOR] fix(alicloud): use comma-ok type assertion in isSDKErrorWithCode by @MartinWeindel [#1173]
  • [OPERATOR] [next-generation] fix: evict stale annotation state entries by @MartinWeindel [#1165]
  • [USER] [next-generation] Fix: re-reconcile conflicting DNSAnnotations after active one is deleted by @MartinWeindel [#1183]

🏃 Others

  • [OPERATOR] Validate and allow configuring the Google service account token_uri by @MartinWeindel [#1164]
  • [OPERATOR] [powerdns,infoblox,rfc2136]: Sanitize provider errors by @MartinWeindel [#1167]
  • [OPERATOR] fix(remote): nil-guard ChangeRequest in UnmarshalChangeRequest by @MartinWeindel [#1168]
  • [OPERATOR] fix(openstack): sanitize Keystone authentication error by @MartinWeindel [#1166]
  • [OPERATOR] [next-generation] Cap dnscache TTL by @MartinWeindel [#1172]
  • [OPERATOR] feat(legacy): Add disable-provider-types option to legacy controller by @MartinWeindel [#1186]
  • [OPERATOR] [powerdns] use dedicated http client per provider. by @MartinWeindel [#1143]

item.title: cobaltcore-dev/aurora-dashboard - @cobaltcore-dev/aurora@2.3.0
item.description:
Minor Changes

  • c65b36d: Consume TanStack Intent skills published by @cloudoperators/juno-ui-components (bumped to 9.7.1). Set up Intent as a consumer at the monorepo root: @tanstack/intent dev dependency, an intent.skills allowlist, and skill-loading guidance in AGENTS.md.
Also fix routeTree.gen.ts not being generated on pnpm run dev by adding the TanStack Router plugin to the dashboard's Vite config and inlining the network/routers/$routerId route id as a string literal (the generator rejects a variable).

Patch Changes

  • a21ba3e: Fix image sharing validation - remove blocking Keystone check
  • a21ba3e: - Exclude pending/rejected shared images from All Images view
- Show permission-based restrictions in bulk action modals - Validate project existence when sharing images - Add 255-char limit to image names (create + update) - Enable direct page navigation (e.g. ?page=6) - Disable bulk actions button when no items selected - Add context-specific empty state messages - Use default text color and size for restriction notices in bulk action modals - Show a "- -" placeholder for empty values in detail views - Explain why reserved/read-only metadata cannot be edited instead of showing a generic error - Keep Create Image disabled while any field (including optional) has a validation error - Reject scientific notation (e.g. 1e5) in Min Disk / Min RAM; allow only digits 0-9 and treat empty as 0 - Clarify sharing error: a project may just not be found (sharing to projects you can't access is allowed) - Show the images list loading indicator as a full-width grid row - Fall empty names back to "- -" in image action modals (ID is shown separately) - Replace remaining "N/A" placeholders with "- -" across image rows, details, and modals - Use theme tokens instead of raw palette colors in the Create Image modal (dark-mode safe) - Reorder Create Image fields so Disk/Container Format sit with the file, grouping required fields - Use the Status component for the empty state in Manage Image Access - Use a neutral Juno Box with a close (X) button for the selected image file (no success icon or colors)

item.title: gardener/external-dns-management - v0.54.0
item.description:
[github.com/gardener/external-dns-management:v0.54.0]

⚠️ Breaking Changes

  • [OPERATOR] aws-route53 providers can only use AWS_USE_CREDENTIALS_CHAIN when the operator has enabled it via the environment variable ALLOW_AWS_CREDENTIALS_CHAIN=true on the dns-controller-manager. Otherwise the provider is rejected during validation. This is typically only relevant for stand alone deployments. by @MartinWeindel [#1155]
  • [USER] DNSEntries with spec.reference set is not supported anymore. It now fails reconciliation instead of inheriting attributes from the referenced entry. by @MartinWeindel [#1162]

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • [OPERATOR] [aws-route53] validate properties even when providerConfig is present. by @MartinWeindel [#1174]
  • [OPERATOR] [next-generation] Release DNS accounts on provider delete and credential rotation. by @MartinWeindel [#1171]
  • [OPERATOR] [next-generation] fix: nil-guard SecretRef in Secret watch map func of source controller by @MartinWeindel [#1161]
  • [OPERATOR] [next-generation] fix(dnsentry): normalize DNS name case before suffix matching by @MartinWeindel [#1163]
  • [OPERATOR] fix(alicloud): use comma-ok type assertion in isSDKErrorWithCode by @MartinWeindel [#1173]
  • [OPERATOR] [next-generation] fix: evict stale annotation state entries by @MartinWeindel [#1165]

item.title: gardener/gardener-extension-auditing - v0.5.0
item.description:
[github.com/gardener/gardener-extension-auditing:v0.5.0]

⚠️ Breaking Changes

  • [OPERATOR] The extension now supports only Gardener installations managed by the Gardener operator, the virtual garden cluster is unconditionally enabled in the helm charts. by @vpnachev [#118]
  • [DEVELOPER] Non-operator local gardener setup has been removed as part of https://github.com/gardener/gardener/issues/11958, now this extension also removed the support for this flavor of local development, i.e. the make targets extension-(up|down|dev) are removed. by @vpnachev [#118]

🏃 Others

  • [OPERATOR] Component binaries are now built with Go 1.26.5 by @dependabot[bot] [#107]
  • [OPERATOR] The update mode of the VerticalPodAutoscaler resources deployed by the gardener-extension-auditing is now explicitly set to InPlaceOrRecreate, reflecting the actual runtime behavior after the unconditional enablement of the VPAInPlaceUpdates feature gate. by @DobromirNPeev [#108]
  • [OPERATOR] Component binaries are now built with golang 1.27.3 by @dependabot[bot] [#123]
  • [OPERATOR] Container base image is now updated to debian13 by @dependabot[bot] [#123]

item.title: gardener/gardener - v1.154.0
item.description:
[github.com/gardener/gardener:v1.154.0]

⚠️ Breaking Changes

  • [OPERATOR] ⚠️ Gardener does no longer support Garden, Seed, or Shoot clusters with Kubernetes version 1.32. Make sure to upgrade all existing clusters before upgrading to this Gardener version. by @ary1992 [#15860]
  • [USER] ⚠️ The deprecated fields .spec.kubernetes.clusterAutoscaler.maxEmptyBulkDelete and .spec.kubernetes.kubeControllerManager.podEvictionTimeout have been removed from the Shoot API. Setting them has been forbidden since Kubernetes 1.33. Use .spec.kubernetes.clusterAutoscaler.maxScaleDownParallelism instead of maxEmptyBulkDelete. by @ary1992 [#15860]
  • [USER] Gardener now forbids manual modification of the gardener.cloud/reference-protection and gardener finalizers for regular users. by @jan-meis [#15822]

📰 Noteworthy

  • [OPERATOR] A dedicated DNSRecord is now created for an explicitly configured dashboard/discovery-server domain, even if it is a subdomain of a runtime ingress domain. This fixes ACME DNS-01 certificate renewal with some DNS providers and means the domain's provider is now honored instead of being ignored. by @cerealsnow [#16006]
  • [OPERATOR] The DisableNginxIngressInShoot feature gate has been promoted to beta. by @ScheererJ [#15929]
  • [DEVELOPER] make gind-down now preserves the shared local infrastructure (DNS, registry, backup bucket, kind docker network) while the gardener-local kind cluster still exists, allowing the DR/restore flow to reuse the kind cluster and its Gardener control plane across iterations. make kind-down remains responsible for tearing the shared infrastructure down. by @Kostov6 [#15841]

✨ New Features

  • [OPERATOR] ETCD encryption key rotation/ config change for the garden cluster now re-encrypts data via the native Kubernetes StorageVersionMigration API (storagemigration.k8s.io/v1) instead of the previous label-based rewrite. This applies when the garden cluster runs Kubernetes >= 1.37, where the StorageVersionMigrator feature is active by default; gardener-operator falls back to the label-based mechanism if the feature gate is explicitly disabled in the virtual-garden-kube-apiserver or virtual-garden-kube-controller-manager, or if the storagemigration.k8s.io/v1 API is disabled via runtime config. by @shafeeqes [#15771]
  • [OPERATOR] Added finalizerrestriction webhook which forbids manual modification of the gardener.cloud/reference-protection and gardener finalizers for regular users. by @jan-meis [#15822]
  • [OPERATOR] Communication with VictoriaLogs is now TLS encrypted and it is on port 9429. by @TeodorDichev [#15725]
  • [USER] ETCD encryption key rotation/ config change for shoot clusters now re-encrypts data via the native Kubernetes StorageVersionMigration API (storagemigration.k8s.io/v1) instead of the previous label-based rewrite. This applies to shoots running Kubernetes >= 1.37, where the StorageVersionMigrator feature is active by default; gardenlet falls back to the label-based mechanism if the feature gate is explicitly disabled in the shoot's kube-apiserver or kube-controller-manager, or if the storagemigration.k8s.io/v1 API is disabled via runtime config. by @shafeeqes [#15771]
  • [USER] When the VictoriaLogsBackend and RemoveVali feature gates are enabled, update all existing dashboards that use Vali as a data source and add a new dashboard dedicated to VictoriaLogs. by @Ilia Petrov [#15769]

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • [OPERATOR] An issue has been fixed that caused a hibernated Shoot's status.hibernated field to be incorrectly set to false at the end of a successful migrate phase of control plane migration. This would then cause the restore phase to get stuck until an operator manually intervened to set the status.hibernated field back to true. by @plkokanov [#16011]
  • [OPERATOR] The ClusterRole of the opentelemetry-operator deployed by gardener-operator now grants read access to httproutes.gateway.networking.k8s.io. Previously, on runtime clusters that have the Gateway API CRDs installed, the operator could not start its informers and never reconciled the OpenTelemetryCollector, leaving the garden logging pipeline down and fluent-bit in a permanent liveness-restart loop. by @anastazya [#15777]
  • [OPERATOR] A bug has been fixed that broke shoot creation in environments where the nodeCIDR is provisioned by the Infrastructure provider by @maboehm [#15966]
  • [OPERATOR] With IstioTLSTermination feature gate, requests from established connections which use client certificate authentication are now rejected when their client certificate expires. by @oliver-goetz [#16055]
  • [OPERATOR] Clients connected to the previous Istio ingress gateway no longer receive errors for the whole kube-apiserver rollout when a shoot's kube-apiserver moves to another Istio ingress gateway, e.g., when updating the shoot to failure tolerance type zone. by @timebertt [#15942]
  • [OPERATOR] The owner role assignment to the owner as project member is moved to PrepareFor(Create|Update) strategy methods because Canonicalize should not add or remove data. by @vpnachev [#15994]
  • [OPERATOR] Relaxed shoot validation in the seed-restriction and shoot-restriction handlers. Earlier, this could have led to failing shoot reconciliations. by @timuthy [#15974]
  • [USER] fix case sensitivity for Connection: Upgrade headers triggering a wrong HTTP 403 response by @crigertg [#15797]
  • [USER] In-place update worker pools (AutoInPlaceUpdate and ManualInPlaceUpdate) are no longer stuck as pending in the Shoot status when an unrelated worker pool fails to become available. by @shafeeqes [#15848]
  • [USER] The OCI Helm chart puller now appends the charts CA bundle from the image vector overwrite onto the system's default certificate pool instead of replacing it, fixing chart pulls from public registries (e.g. europe-docker.pkg.dev) when a self-signed registry CA is also configured. by @ialidzhikov [#15937]
  • [USER] kube-proxy is now restarted when it reports unhealthy for about one minute. This works around a bug in kube-proxy v1.34+ where a failed initial sync was not retried for up to one hour, leaving the pod unready. by @timebertt [#16007]

🏃 Others

  • [OPERATOR] Removed the BackupEntryForGarden feature gate which has been GA since v1.153. by @rfranzke [#15920]
  • [OPERATOR] Resources managed by a ManagedResource (labeled resources.gardener.cloud/managed-by=gardener) are no longer deleted during the Kubernetes resource cleanup phase of shoot deletion. by @Velin-Todorov [#15905]
  • [OPERATOR] The gardener/autoscaler image for Shoots with Kubernetes version 1.36 has been updated to v1.36.0. Release Notes by @r4mek [#15970]
  • [OPERATOR] The obsolete implicit internal-DNS configuration via a Secret labeled gardener.cloud/role=internal-domain has been removed. Seeds must use the required Seed.spec.dns.internal field, the only supported mechanism since v1.129. The internal-domain-secret.gardener.cloud admission webhook has been removed accordingly. by @DobromirNPeev [#15913]
  • [OPERATOR] Remove fixed NodeCIDRMaskSizeIPv6=64 default for dual-stack shoots.
The effective per-node IPv6 mask is now derived from the actual pod CIDR (podCIDRMaskSize+16, capped at /124), fixing single-node clusters on infrastructures that hand out a /64 pod range. by @axel7born [#15943]
  • [OPERATOR] Self-hosted shoot clusters now deploy their own istio when connected to a Garden cluster. by @ScheererJ [#15874]
  • [OPERATOR] gardenadm restore now cleans up the stale OperatingSystemConfig Secret and the shoot-gardener-node-agent ManagedResource restored from the ETCD snapshot during the bootstrap flow, fixing an unrecoverable failure where the restored control plane ran with two etcds. by @dimitar-kostadinov [#15949]
  • [OPERATOR] Fixed a deadlock in gardenadm restore where etcd-druid could not reconcile the restored ETCDs because of stale etcd member Leases. by @ialidzhikov [#16022]
  • [OPERATOR] Gardener now exposes a metric regarding the status of constraints on a Garden object. This metric is used to generate the GardenManagedResourcesHonoredConstraintStatusNotTrue alert in case a constraint's status remains unhealthy (false) for more than 20 minutes. by @hammadzf [#15824]
  • [OPERATOR] gardener-operator now reconciles the Garden when an Extension is created, deleted, or its .spec.resources change (e.g., when autoEnable: [garden] is added), instead of waiting for the next sync period. by @Wieneo [#15932]
  • [OPERATOR] The gardener user is now recreated with its original UID/GID after a wipe-based in-place OS upgrade (where /etc is reset but /home survives), preventing /home/gardener and other files owned by the gardener user from becoming orphaned. by @acumino [#16038]
  • [OPERATOR] gardener-user.service now has an [Install] section so that it is started on first boot when the provision OSC is applied via Ignition (e.g. by os-coreos). This fixes gardenadm bootstrap failing to SSH into control plane machines because the gardener user was never created. by @robinschneider [#15939]
  • [OPERATOR] The following dependencies have been updated:
- gardener/etcd-druid from v0.38.2 to v0.39.0. Release Notes - github.com/gardener/etcd-druid/api from v0.38.2 to v0.39.0. by @Shreyas S [#15902]
  • [DEVELOPER] gardener-node-agent is now built as a multi-arch image in remote-setup. This enables the seed and shoot to have differing architectures. by @wpross [#15944]
  • [DEVELOPER] A new hack/gardenadm-restore-clean-orphaned-resources.sh script force-removes the garden-side resources that leak into the reusable kind cluster when make gind-down deletes the self-hosted shoot cluster, enabling a clean subsequent gardenadm restore run without recreating the kind cluster. by @Kostov6 [#15859]
  • [DEPENDENCY] The following dependencies have been updated:
- gcr.io/istio-release/pilot from 1.29.8 to 1.29.9. - gcr.io/istio-release/proxyv2 from 1.29.8 to 1.29.9. - istio.io/api from v1.29.8 to v1.29.9. by @renovate[bot] [#16023]
  • [DEPENDENCY] The following dependencies have been updated:
- registry.k8s.io/node-problem-detector/node-problem-detector from v1.35.3 to v1.35.4. by @renovate[bot] [#15997]

item.title: openmcp-project/service-provider-otel-operator - Release v1.0.1
item.description:
Changelog

🚀 Features

#### [USER]

  • version bump (#99, @MichaelSp)

🐛 Bugfixes

#### [USER]

  • Fix crash-loop of otel-operator when using opentelemetry-kube-stack chart >= 0.23.1: disable the operator.networkpolicy feature gate which is on by default since otel-operator v0.159.0 and incompatible with the split-cluster topology. (#95, @MichaelSp)

  • fix(deps): update module github.com/fluxcd/pkg/apis/kustomize to v1.23.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/openmcp-project/service-provider-otel-operator/pull/90

item.title: gardener/opentelemetry-collector - v0.0.2
item.description:
[github.com/gardener/opentelemetry-collector:v0.0.2]

✨ New Features

  • [OPERATOR] Add config validations for Kubeconfig and Namespace in Gardener receiver by @chrkl [#64]
  • [OPERATOR] Add Gardener metrics receiver by @chrkl [#23]
  • [USER] Collect metrics for Shoot and Seed constraints in gardenerreceiver by @hammadzf [#122]
  • [USER] Adjust to Gardener API deprecations by @chrkl [#25]
  • [USER] Introduce a new extension that integrates the OpenTelemetry Collector with the sd_notify protocol. by @iypetrov [#32]
  • [USER] Optimize informer cache usage by removing unnecessary attributes from cached objects by @chrkl [#24]
  • [USER] Updated all components, removed Loki exporter, and included the pprofextension component. by @rrhubenov [#19]
  • [USER] Adds WATCHDOG=1 keep-alive support to the sdnotify extension so systemd can detect and restart a unhealthy collector. by @iypetrov [#52]
  • [USER] Refactor condition metrics to reduce cardinality by @chrkl [#73]
  • [USER] Add business-critical attribute to shoot metrics by @chrkl [#119]
  • [USER] Fixes a bug where the sdnotify extension emitted STOPPING=1 during a Type=notify-reload in-process reload, which caused systemd to flip the unit into deactivating mid-reload and stall the entire reload cycle. by @iypetrov [#54]
  • [USER] Switch sdnotify extension to upstream version by @chrkl [#105]
  • [DEVELOPER] Add Gardener Receiver e2e test by @chrkl [#67]
  • [DEVELOPER] Add Renovate grouping for Gardener dependencies by @chrkl [#44]
  • [DEVELOPER] Add kind/enhancement label to renovate pull requests by @chrkl [#31]
  • [DEVELOPER] Run Gardener receiver e2e tests for PR validation by @chrkl [#134]
  • [DEVELOPER] Group Go version updates across Docker and Actions for renovate PRs by @chrkl [#82]

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • [USER] Send STOPPING=1 reliably on shutdown. by @iypetrov [#70]
  • [DEVELOPER] Fix gardenerreceiver e2e test by @chrkl [#128]
  • [DEVELOPER] Fix using PromQL client in e2e tests by @chrkl [#124]

🏃 Others

  • [DEVELOPER] Switch from Dependabot to Renovate by @chrkl [#27]

📖 Documentation

  • [USER] Add documentation for Gardener metrics receiver by @chrkl [#61]

item.title: gardener/gardener-extension-provider-gcp - v1.57.0
item.description:
[github.com/gardener/gardener-extension-provider-gcp:v1.57.0]

✨ New Features

  • [OPERATOR] Add bring-your-own subnet support by @hebelsan [#1493]
  • [USER] This extension now supports shoot clusters with Kubernetes version 1.37. You should consider the Kubernetes release notes before upgrading to 1.37. by @acumino [#1532]
  • [USER] Add advancedMachineFeatures.enableNestedVirtualization to GCP WorkerConfig. When set to true, the worker pool VMs are created with nested virtualization enabled. by @lizzzcai [#1523]

🏃 Others

  • [OPERATOR] Controller only registers for the extension classes it actually handles by @hebelsan [#1513]
  • [DEPENDENCY] The following container images have been updated:
- cloud-controller-manager: v36.0.7 -> v36.0.21 (patch) - csi-driver: v1.26.0 -> v1.27.1 (singleton) - csi-driver-filestore: v1.12.0 -> v1.12.2 (singleton) - csi-provisioner: v6.3.0 -> v6.4.0 (singleton) - csi-resizer: v2.2.1 -> v2.3.0 (singleton) - machine-controller-manager-provider-gcp: v0.28.1 -> v0.29.0 (singleton) by @federated-github-access[bot] [#1525]

item.title: cobaltcore-dev/openstack-hypervisor-operator - v1.3.0 better eviction
item.description:
v1.3.0

Parallel VM migrations while draining hypervisors, safe eviction completion, and hardened offboarding.

⚠️ Upgrade notes

  • --agent-namespaces is now required. The operator refuses to start without it. It controls the namespaces searched for agent pods (nova-compute, neutron) during offboarding. Helm users are not affected (chart default: monsoon3); anyone deploying the image directly or with customized values must set controllerManager.manager.env.agentNamespaces (comma-separated).
  • New optional chart values controllerManager.manager.env.evictionConcurrency (default "1") and evictionTraitConcurrency (default empty).

New features

Parallel VM migrations while draining a hypervisor (#365)

Drains previously migrated VMs strictly one at a time; you can now run multiple live migrations in flight with a configurable limit:
  • --eviction-concurrency — default maximum number of concurrent migrations (default 1, i.e. the previous serial behavior)
  • --eviction-trait-concurrency — per-trait overrides, e.g. CUSTOM_HANA_EXCLUSIVE_HOST=1,CUSTOM_FOO=2; the lowest matching trait limit wins
  • Helm chart exposes both as evictionConcurrency / evictionTraitConcurrency values (rendered as EVICTION_CONCURRENCY / EVICTION_TRAIT_CONCURRENCY env vars)

Eviction completes only after incoming migrations settle

A host could previously be declared evicted while Nova still had migrations in flight targeting it (Nova keeps instances associated with the source host while a live migration runs). The operator now queries Nova's /os-migrations and, before declaring a hypervisor evicted:
  • aborts abortable incoming live-migrations (queued / preparing / running) aimed at the host
  • waits for non-abortable ones (evacuations, post-migrating state)
  • adds an IncomingMigrationsSettled condition to the Hypervisor CR (reasons Settled, AbortingIncomingMigrations, WaitingForIncomingMigrations); a failed Nova check blocks eviction and is visible in status instead of being silently ignored

Hardened offboarding

  • The kvm.cloud.sap/offboarding NoExecute taint is applied only after all VMs are evicted (Evicting=False), so agent pods are no longer pushed off a node mid-migration
  • Compute-service (Nova service entry) deletion is gated on a new AgentPodsEvicted condition on the Hypervisor CR — a running nova-compute pod would otherwise re-register the service immediately after deletion
  • HA protection is kept until successfully onboarded hosts are drained; a successful onboarding is no longer overwritten during maintenance

Node termination detection via deletionTimestamp

Gardener is moving away from setting the legacy Terminating node condition toward simply deleting the Node. The Hypervisor Terminating condition — and MaintenanceTermination seeding at CR creation — now trigger on the legacy condition or node.deletionTimestamp.

Reliability & performance

  • GOMEMLIMIT is set from the container memory limit so the Go GC respects the cgroup limit (prevents OOM kills)
  • OpenStack provider clients are cached per auth context — the Keystone service catalog is deserialized once instead of once per controller
  • Deployment/PodDisruptionBudget informers scoped to the maintenance objects in kube-system only (smaller cache footprint)
  • The Gardener node-lifecycle signal pod now exits promptly on SIGTERM

Internals

  • HypervisorMaintenanceController migrated to server-side apply for status updates and Eviction creation (new SSA condition helpers in internal/utils)
  • Eviction controller extracted into its own internal/controller/eviction package
  • Onboarding controller made testable (injectable clients, requeue interval); --version now works without the other runtime flags
  • CRDs regenerated with controller-gen v0.22.0 (doc fixes only; no schema changes beyond the new conditions)

Dependencies & tooling

  • Go 1.26 → 1.27; k8s.io/* 0.36 → 0.37.1; controller-runtime 0.24 → 0.25.2
  • gophercloud v2.12 → v2.15.0; cert-manager v1.20 → v1.21; sapcc/go-api-declarations 1.22 → 1.25
  • Security: OpenTelemetry → v1.45.0; ginkgo v2.33.1; actions/checkout v7; actions/stale v11
Full Changelog: https://github.com/cobaltcore-dev/openstack-hypervisor-operator/compare/v1.2.3...v1.3.0

item.title: open-resource-discovery/specification - v1.17.0
item.description:
Added

  • Added relatedDataProducts to Data Products for expressing typed relationships to other Data Products through extensible reference objects.
  • Added Arazzo Specification support for describing multi-step API workflows.
- Added standardized Capability type workflow with definition type arazzo-v1. - Added arazzo-v1 to ORD Overlay target definition types. - Added ord:orchestrates as a relatedApiResources.relationType value for declaring that the source resource orchestrates the target API Resource.
  • Added optional describedSystemInstance.globalId property for a globally unique and stable tenant identifier assigned by the responsible tenant authority.
It records the same identity that can be passed as the Global-Tenant-Id header in the open and basic-auth access strategies. ORD Overlays support the same identifier in describedSystemInstance and target.systemInstance, with matching identity semantics and validation constraints. Cross-linked localId/Local-Tenant-Id and globalId/Global-Tenant-Id between the ORD Document interface and the access-strategy documentation.
  • Added systemTypes to IntegrationAspect for dependencies on system types that do not require a specific resource contract, including an optional minimum system version.
  • Added standardized Capability types agent-skill and agent-plugin, with agent-skill-zip and agent-plugin-zip definitions for distributing skills and plugin bundles as ZIP archives.
  • Added integrationDependencies to Capabilities, allowing them to declare required API Resources, Event Resources, or other Capabilities. Dependencies on bundling capabilities such as agent plugins can use subset.skillName to identify only the required skills. See AI Agents and Protocols: Skill Dependencies.
  • Added partOfProducts, responsible, lifecycle metadata, taxonomy, policyLevels, and extensible to Capabilities for consistency with other ORD resources and support for custom fields.
  • Added support for OpenAPI Initiative Overlay v1.0.0: API Resources can publish oas-overlay-v1 definitions, and ORD Overlays can target them. The ORD Overlay documentation now explains how the two overlay specifications interoperate.
  • Added the sap:documentation:v1 policy level for human-readable metadata requirements. sap:core:v1 now inherits this policy level.

Changed

  • Made IntegrationAspect.title optional. Existing documents remain valid, but consumers MUST handle aspects without a title, for example by deriving a display label from the referenced resources or system types.
The exported TypeScript Aspect.title property is now optional; consumers that assumed a title was always present may require source changes when upgrading. Documents with title-less aspects do not validate against earlier schemas.
  • Allowed customer-namespaced ORD IDs to be published globally when the allocating platform guarantees global uniqueness across customer scopes; otherwise partner content still requires ORD IDs under the partner's registered vendor namespace.
  • Clarified native resource-definition version alignment: versions SHOULD match ORD versions where possible; non-SemVer versions must be converted while preserving ordering and compatibility semantics as closely as possible. Aligned the schema description with the existing overview and concept guidance.
  • Clarified identifier and lifecycle guidance: Specification IDs do not allow / in the specification identifier, runtime extensions MAY use SemVer build metadata but MUST update lastUpdate, and decommissioned resources or unused taxonomy require tombstones; resources may be removed or retained with releaseStatus: sunset and a sunsetDate.
  • sap:core:v1 now requires all ORD Overlays to have effective internal or private visibility and requires SAP publishers to use ord:overlay:v1 rather than oas-overlay-v1 for published overlays.
-----------------------------

Merged PRs

  • Update GitHub release action by @nirooxx in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/195
  • Improve mobile navbar responsiveness by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/196
  • Add SAP Documentation v1 policy level by @pavelkornev in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/199
  • Restore ORD Concepts link in specification menu by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/200
  • Align ORD introduction, landing page, and presentation diagrams by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/203
  • Improve ORD ecosystem and onboarding links by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/197
  • Improve the ORD landing and Help pages by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/204
  • docs: synchronize specification diagrams with presentation by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/205
  • Clarify native version alignment and SemVer conversion by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/211
  • Link concept guides directly to matching presentation topics by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/210
  • Align diagram captions and Agent explanations with the ORD model by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/209
  • Keep replacement diagrams readable and preserve perspective rules by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/208
  • docs: require non-public visibility for ORD overlays in sap:core:v1 by @nirooxx in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/207
  • docs: restructure specification documentation by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/212
  • docs: reconcile identifier, versioning, and publication guidance by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/213
  • docs: allow globally unique customer namespace IDs by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/214
  • Clarify customer and partner ownership semantics by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/216
  • Support Agent Skills and Agent Plugins as ORD capability types by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/102
  • Align Capability metadata with other ORD resources by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/202
  • Add extensibility to Capabilities by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/183
  • Allow Integration Dependencies on system types by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/181
  • Make IntegrationAspect.title optional by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/215
  • Add describedSystemInstance.globalId for global tenant correlation by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/174
  • Add Arazzo workflow support by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/158
  • Add OpenAPI Overlay v1 resource definition support by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/157
  • Add related Data Product relationships by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/188
  • Release v1.17.0 by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/217
  • chore: update changelog for version 1.17.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/220

New Contributors

  • @github-actions[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/specification/pull/220

item.title: gardener/etcd-druid - v0.39.0
item.description:
[github.com/gardener/etcd-druid:v0.39.0]

⚠️ Breaking Changes

  • [OPERATOR] Adds spec.etcd.additionalAdvertisedURLs to the Etcd API, consolidating per-member client and peer URL advertisement under a single field. Operators can configure extra URLs alongside or instead of the default internal Kubernetes service URL. The overrideDefaultURL flag suppresses the default URL when needed, for example during live control-plane migration when source members must advertise external-only addresses. by @seshachalam-yv [#1438]
  • [OPERATOR] Scale-in support requires the UpgradeEtcdVersion feature gate to be enabled. This gate is beta and enabled by default, so no action is needed in a default setup. If you have explicitly disabled UpgradeEtcdVersion, scale-in (and bootstrapWithExistingCluster member decommissioning) will fail: the deployed etcd-backup-restore version (v0.41.2) does not support member removal, so the removed member gets added back. by @seshachalam-yv [#1426]

📰 Noteworthy

  • [OPERATOR] The pre-sync EtcdOpsTask name prefix is renamed from presync-snapshot-upgrade- to presync-snapshot-update-; in-flight tasks created by an older operator may result in at most one additional snapshot across the upgrade. by @anveshreddy18 [#1360]
  • [OPERATOR] Runtime base image bumped from distroless/static-debian11 to distroless/static-debian12 to address Debian 11 EOL (PCI/ISP-013 finding). by @ccwienk [#1435]
  • [OPERATOR] Changes the default value of autoCompactionRetention period from 30mins to 15mins. by @ishan16696 [#1439]
  • [OPERATOR] enable featuregate: UpgradeEtcdVersion even when field is unset. by @Shreyas-s14 [#1449]
  • [USER] Upgrade the maturity level of UpgradeEtcdVersion featuregate to Beta, it will upgrade etcd cluster to v3.5.x. Please set the featuregate: UpgradeEtcdVersion to false if don't want to upgrade etcd cluster. by @Shreyas-s14 [#1436]

✨ New Features

  • [OPERATOR] Etcd CR now supports spec.etcd.{env,volumeMounts}, spec.backup.{env,volumeMounts}, and spec.volumes fields to specify additional environment variables, volume mounts, and volumes for the etcd-wrapper and backup-restore containers in the StatefulSet. by @CaptainIRS [#1319]
  • [OPERATOR] Operators can now safely scale in HA etcd clusters by reducing spec.replicas. During scale-in, etcd-druid removes surplus etcd members one at a time, performing a quorum-safety check before each removal. The StatefulSet is shrunk only after the corresponding member has been safely decommissioned, and surplus PVCs are cleaned up as part of the same operation, preventing both quorum loss and storage leaks.
A new ScaleOperationComplete status condition provides visibility into scaling operations, indicating whether a scale operation is in progress (False/ScalingIn, False/ScalingOut, or False/BootstrapMembersRemoval) or the cluster is idle (True/NoScaleOperation). CRD-level CEL validation also prevents conflicting scale operations while another membership operation is in progress. Members from the source cluster configured through spec.etcd.bootstrapWithExistingCluster can now be decommissioned declaratively by removing them from the specification or clearing the field. These members are removed through the same quorum-safe member removal flow under the BootstrapMembersRemoval reason. See DEP-08 for more details. by @seshachalam-yv [#1426]

🏃 Others

  • [OPERATOR] Removed StatefulSet access from the etcd pod's ServiceAccount Role as it is no longer needed by etcd-backup-restore. by @priyadharshini-151193 [#1430]
  • [OPERATOR] Added Test Path Parameter to run e2e test for individual modules. by @Shreyas-s14 [#1410]
  • [OPERATOR] Upgrade the alpine image version to 3.23.4 by @ishan16696 [#1437]
  • [OPERATOR] Take a full snapshot via EtcdOpsTask before the etcd StatefulSet is rolled due to any container image change or replica count change, in both HA and non-HA setups by @anveshreddy18 [#1360]
  • [DEVELOPER] Enable UpgradeEtcdVersion feature gate by default in local e2e testing via make ci-e2e-kind. by @seshachalam-yv [#1409]

[github.com/gardener/etcd-wrapper:v0.8.2]

📰 Noteworthy

  • [OPERATOR] Runtime base image bumped from distroless/static-debian11 to distroless/static-debian12 to address Debian 11 EOL (PCI/ISP-013 finding). by @ccwienk [#102]

[github.com/gardener/etcd-backup-restore:v0.45.0]

📰 Noteworthy

  • [USER] REVERTED: Removed deprecated support for passing storage endpoint via credential secrets for AWS, GCP & Azure. Users must now use the --store-endpoint-override flag for custom endpoints (emulators, S3-compatible providers, regional endpoints). The following credential secret fields are no longer supported: endpoint (S3), domain/emulatorEnabled (Azure), storageAPIEndpoint/emulatorEnabled (GCS). by @anveshreddy18 [#1057]

✨ New Features

  • [OPERATOR] When the ENDPOINTS environment variable is set to a file path, etcd-backup-restore derives etcd client endpoints and served advertise URLs dynamically from that file and a live member list call to the etcd cluster, instead of static config-map entries. A background refresh loop (--enable-endpoints-refresh, --endpoints-refresh-interval) keeps the file current. An empty file is valid bootstrap state. by @CaptainIRS [#1053]
  • [OPERATOR] Added a membership removal check to etcd-backup-restore that prevents a scaled-in etcd member from re-adding itself as a learner after etcd-druid removes it during a scale-in operation. by @seshachalam-yv [#1058]

🏃 Others

  • [OPERATOR] Re-trigger release to fix component-descriptors. (no code changes) by @CaptainIRS [#1064]

[github.com/gardener/etcd-backup-restore:v0.45.1]

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • [OPERATOR] etcd-backup-restore now re-reads the etcd cluster size on every initialization instead of only at process startup for multi-node cluster, so a member whose data directory is corrupted after a scale-out rejoins the existing cluster as a learner instead of restoring from a backup snapshot and bootstrapping a new single-member cluster. by @seshachalam-yv [#1080]

[github.com/gardener/etcd-backup-restore:v0.44.2]

🏃 Others

  • [OPERATOR] Re-trigger release to fix component-descriptors. (no code changes) by @CaptainIRS [#1069]

Helm Charts

  • etcd-druid: europe-docker.pkg.dev/gardener-project/releases/charts/gardener/etcd-druid:v0.39.0

Container (OCI) Images

item.title: openmcp-project/service-provider-argocd - Release v0.1.0
item.description:
Changelog

🚀 Features

#### [USER]

  • openmcp.cloud/operation=ignore to pause reconciliation, or openmcp.cloud/operation=reconcile to trigger an immediate one-shot reconcile. The reconcile annotation is automatically removed after the controller processes it. (#29, @erolclk1)
  • The ArgoCD server can now be exposed externally on Gardener via ArgoCD.spec.exposure (managed DNS + TLS), with platform-level DNS/cert policy and an optional Stakater Reloader addon configured through ProviderConfig. (#25, @erolclk1)

➕ Other

item.title: konfidence-project/konfidence - 0.1.0-alpha.1
item.description:
Welcome to Konfidence

Konfidence 0.1.0-alpha.1 is the first alpha release of Konfidence. Konfidence packages multi-component applications as immutable vectors and promotes them across stages on Kubernetes. This release contains the operators, the API server with its dashboard, and the kden CLI.

This is an alpha release, and some parts don't work yet

Expect rough edges. Some features are incomplete, and some may not work at all. APIs, custom resources, and CLI commands can change between alpha releases without a migration path. Don't run this release in production.

We improve quality with every release from here on

We keep working on the quality of Konfidence release by release. The bugs you report decide what we fix first. The changelog below lists everything that changed since 0.0.1-alpha.1.

New contributors are welcome

Try Konfidence and tell us what breaks. Questions, bug reports, and pull requests of any size are welcome.
  • Start with the Quickstart Guide.
  • Report bugs and gaps in GitHub issues.
  • Open a pull request for any fix.

item.description:
[github.com/gardener/gardener-extension-shoot-cert-service:v1.66.0]

✨ New Features

  • [USER] Adds an optional caInjector field to the CertConfig. When enabled, the cert-controller-manager runs additional controllers that automatically populate the caBundle of ValidatingWebhookConfiguration, MutatingWebhookConfiguration, CustomResourceDefinition (conversion webhooks), and APIService resources via cert.gardener.cloud/inject-ca-from / cert.gardener.cloud/inject-ca-from-secret annotations. Disabled by default. by @MartinWeindel [#616]

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • [OPERATOR] Bugfix: Shoot MR can be leaked on transient error during MR deletion by @MartinWeindel [#610]

[github.com/gardener/cert-management:v0.28.0]

  • [USER] Add opt-in CA injector to populate the caBundle of ValidatingWebhookConfiguration, MutatingWebhookConfiguration,
CustomResourceDefinition conversion webhooks and APIServices from a CA source driven by annotations by @MartinWeindel [#826]
  • [USER] Support subject, literalSubject, and usages for CA and self-signed certificates. by @MartinWeindel [#813]

🐛 Bug Fixes

item.title: open-resource-discovery/overlay-editor - v0.2.3
item.description:
What's new?

Changed

  • Bumped to @open-resource-discovery/ui-components@^0.2.0. The library now ships its own .ord-ui-scoped element reset and Tailwind preflight at specificity (0,1,0), which beats Infima's unlayered (0,0,1) selectors outright. As a result, the consumer-side workarounds that were previously needed are removed:
- The hand-rolled .overlay-root-scoped preflight in src/lib/styles.css is deleted — the overlay is rendered inside .ord-ui, so the library's reset covers it. - The Infima-bleed neutralization block in website/src/css/custom.css (the :where(.ord-ui) p/h1…h6/ul/ol/… margin and font-size resets) is deleted.
  • Fixed the appearance of the left-pane overlay selector: corrected border, padding, and card title font-size by switching to Tailwind important-modifier utilities (border-b!, border-border!, p-2!, text-sm!) so the correct values take precedence over any inherited host styles.
  • Tightened the standalone bundle's CSS scoping in vite.standalone.config.ts: .ord-ui is no longer treated as an already-scoped selector, so ui-components' own .ord-ui-scoped reset and token rules are further prefixed with .overlay-card-view in the standalone bundle. This prevents the globally-loaded bundle from re-applying the element reset to the Docusaurus chrome, which was zeroing Input/Card borders in the playground header.
  • Fixed Vitest crashes when running tests against a symlinked (file:) ui-components dependency: added resolve.dedupe for React and inlined @open-resource-discovery/ui-components and @base-ui/* in vitest.config.ts to force a single React instance and avoid "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'useState')" hook errors.

------

What's Changed

  • Feat/upgrade UI components by @aneta-a in #62
  • chore(deps): consolidate Renovate dependency updates by @aneta-a in #55

item.title: gardener/machine-controller-manager - v0.63.0
item.description:
[github.com/gardener/machine-controller-manager:v0.63.0]

✨ New Features

  • [OPERATOR] Support node.machine.sapcloud.io/effective-creation-timeout on MachineDeployment to override shoot configured machineControllerManager.machineCreationTimeout for use by dependency-watchdog by @elankath [#1104]
  • [OPERATOR] Support new metrics: machine_create_duration_seconds, machine_initialize_duration_seconds, machine_join_duration_seconds,machine_drain_duration_seconds,machine_delete_duration_seconds by @elankath [#1104]
  • [DEVELOPER] Introduce simulation provider to run integration tests for MCM without an actual cluster by @takoverflow [#1129]

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • [OPERATOR] Fix for Machine getting stuck with empty phase when finalizer addition exhausts retry budget by @elankath [#1142]
  • [OPERATOR] Ensure auto-preserve failed machines are ordered by their PreserveExpiryTime in case of deletion due to reduction is mcs.spec.Replica or mcs.spec.autoPreserveFailedMachineMax by @aaronfern [#1138]
  • [OPERATOR] Patch machine.Spec.Class.Name on machine object with the new machine class's name after it undergoes an inplace update. by @thiyyakat [#1153]
  • [OPERATOR] Fix preservation reconcile loop to avoid unconditionally uncordoning nodes unrelated to machine preservation, prevent spurious writes on non-preserved machines, and eliminate conflict errors caused by stale machine object comparison in the defer annotation sync. by @gardener-ci-robot [#1118]
  • [OPERATOR] MCM now deletes the backing node when its machine is force-deleted, and clears finalizers on nodes terminating without a backing machine.
Machine creation status is also modified to distinguish cloud provider failures from node registration failures. by @gagan16k [#1102]
  • [OPERATOR] Fix drain error drop in preservation flow where a failed drain on a previously-visited preserved node would not cause the reconciler to retry fast enough. by @thiyyakat [#1145]
  • [OPERATOR] Prevent error while evicting pod X: pod disruption budget X/X is misconfigured and requires zero voluntary evictions when pods are being evicted by @Kumm-Kai [#1127]
  • [DEVELOPER] Revert changes on machineTerminationFlow which caused a machine to be stuck in Terminating phase by @gagan16k [#1157]

🏃 Others

  • [OPERATOR] The orphan-VM safety controller no longer deletes the backing VM of a preserved machine. by @gagan16k [#1146]
  • [OPERATOR] De-couple cordoning and drain in the various operations that involve draining such as updates and machine preservation. by @thiyyakat [#1119]
  • [DEVELOPER] Added integration tests for machine preservation by @aaronfern [#1124]

item.title: gardener/gardener-extension-provider-alicloud - v1.74.0
item.description:
[github.com/gardener/gardener-extension-provider-alicloud:v1.74.0]

✨ New Features

  • [USER] This extension now supports shoot clusters with Kubernetes version 1.36.
You should consider the Kubernetes release notes before upgrading to 1.36. by @ary1992 [#933]

🏃 Others

  • [OPERATOR] Add support for machine preservation by distributing the value of worker[].machineControllerManager.autoPreserveFailedMachineMax across zones. by @thiyyakat [#934]
  • [OPERATOR] Provider-alicloud now deploys a new default volumesnapshotclass. by @kevin-lacoo [#942]
  • [OPERATOR] Update alicloud-controller-manager to v2.15.0 by @kevin-lacoo [#936]
  • [OPERATOR] Update following images version: csi-plugin-alicloud to v1.36.2, csi-attacher to v4.12.0, csi-node-driver-registrar to v2.17.0, csi-snapshotter to v8.6.0, csi-snapshot-controller to v8.6.0, csi-liveness-probe to v2.19.0 by @kevin-lacoo [#935]
  • [OPERATOR] The dependency github.com/gardener/gardener has been updated from v1.147.2 to v1.150.1. by @kevin-lacoo [#945]
  • [OPERATOR] Add BYO infrastructure support for Alicloud shoots: users can provide pre-existing VSwitches (workersVSwitchID) and/or a Security Group (nodesSecurityGroupID) in InfrastructureConfig. Gardener treats these resources as read-only and performs no environment setup for BYO shoots. by @kevin-lacoo [#922]
  • [OPERATOR] Prevent Calico from setting the NetworkUnavailable condition on nodes when overlay networking gets disabled, and ensures cleanup of existing Calico-set conditions. by @kevin-lacoo [#941]
  • [OPERATOR] You can now configure if the deployed storageclass and volumesnapshotclass are marked as default. by @kevin-lacoo [#942]

item.title: gardener/gardener-extension-provider-openstack - v1.58.0
item.description:
[github.com/gardener/gardener-extension-provider-openstack:v1.58.0]

✨ New Features

  • [OPERATOR] Enable security group management for OVN load balancers so that Kubernetes loadBalancerSourceRanges are enforced out of the box. by @Lappihuan [#1398]
  • [USER] This extension now supports shoot clusters with Kubernetes version 1.36.
You should consider the Kubernetes release notes before upgrading to 1.36. by @tobschli [#1390]
  • [USER] OpenStack Shoot clusters can now configure cloudControllerManager.internalLoadBalancer in their ControlPlaneConfig. When enabled, all Services of type LoadBalancer are provisioned as internal load balancers without floating IPs. by @stblatzheim [#1417]

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • [OPERATOR] fix gardenctl ssh floating ip attachment by @modzilla99 [#1411]
  • [OPERATOR] Don't read bastion floating IP from Nova server addresses by @hebelsan [#1419]

🏃 Others

  • [OPERATOR] The update mode of the VerticalPodAutoscaler resource, deployed by gardener-extension-provider-openstack, is now explicitly set to InPlaceOrRecreate, reflecting the actual runtime behavior after the unconditional enablement of the VPAInPlaceUpdates feature gate. by @Velin-Todorov [#1397]
  • [OPERATOR] Add support for machine preservation by distributing the value of worker[].machineControllerManager.autoPreserveFailedMachineMax across zones. by @thiyyakat [#1409]
  • [OPERATOR] Controller only registers for the extension classes it actually handles by @hebelsan [#1424]

item.title: open-resource-discovery/provider-server - v1.2.5
item.description:
Changed

  • For huge repositories we need to take care of EMFILE errors, as we might write (and have opened) too many files. Therefore we have a concurrency limited wrapper for fs.

Commits

  • 1931c8b fix: limit concurrent fs writes to prevent EMFILE on large repos (#407) (Juri J.)

item.description:
What's new?

Added

  • Added automated GitHub release creation.
  • Added changelog-based release notes.
  • Added configurable tag templates and release metadata.
  • Added contributor detection and GitHub-native mentions.
  • Added optional CI workflow dispatch for generated changelog PRs.

------

  • feat: add What's new? heading to release body before changelog content by test-actor in 5710120

item.title: gardener/aws-ipam-controller - v0.11.0
item.description:
[github.com/gardener/aws-ipam-controller:v0.11.0]

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • [OPERATOR] Fixed a goroutine leak in the CIDR allocator: if state reconciliation failed or the controller context was cancelled mid-reconcile, in-flight node events would block forever on the reconcile-ready signal. by @DockToFuture [#374]
  • [OPERATOR] Fixed a panic on node deletion in dual-stack clusters with IPv6-primary address family that caused the controller to restart on every node removal.
Fixed a race condition on controller restart that could assign a CIDR already in use, leaving affected nodes with pod networking failures until the next restart. by @axel7born [#373]

  • [USER] Custom CoreDNS server blocks that reference plugins not compiled into node-local-dns (e.g. file, ready, kubernetes) no longer crash-loop node-local-dns; the adapter rewrites them to forward to the in-cluster CoreDNS instead. item.title: open-resource-discovery/global-registry-bot - v0.1.9
item.description:
Request Bot Core Refactor and Webhook Reliability

  • Refactored the request handler into event, runtime, composition, and infrastructure layers.
  • Reduced the main request orchestrator by moving runtime wiring into dedicated composition modules.
  • Added async webhook dispatch so GitHub webhooks are acknowledged quickly while heavy bot work continues in the background.
  • Preserved existing bot behavior, event flow, callback contracts, and log messages.

item.title: open-resource-discovery/pr-preview-action - v0.0.1
item.description:
Added

  • Added internal QR code generation for PR preview links using vendored segno.
  • Added QR PNG deployment alongside the preview output.
  • Added asset reachability checks before posting the PR preview comment.
  • Added cache-busted QR image URLs to avoid stale or broken image rendering.

Changed

  • Replaced the external QR provider with fully local QR generation.
  • QR codes are now enabled by default without sending preview URLs to third-party services.
  • PR comments now use the validated QR image URL after preview deployment.

Security

  • Removed third-party QR provider usage to prevent preview URL leakage.
  • Reduced MITM, tracking, and external service dependency risks for QR generation.

Commits

  • 609e619 Merge pull request #7 from open-resource-discovery/feat/internal-qr-generation (Nangiale Shir)
  • a448498 Update README + prettier check . (Shir)
  • f8bb793 Added CHANGELOG, package version, github-release and Updated gitignore (Shir)
  • 74fc0cb use repo raw image URL for QR comments on GHES (Shir)
  • 3b8720d replace blocked health check action with github-script (Shir)
  • 16c5cca replace custom wait logic with URL health check action (Shir)
  • 89ee659 handle compressed QR responses in asset validation (Shir)
  • e106946 check QR asset without cache buster before commenting (Shir)
  • 819d083 refine QR polling with backoff and separate wait settings (Shir)
  • 4cf7f78 make QR validation best effort after preview check (Shir)
  • c2f9f66 fix: replace heredoc with python -c one-liner to fix YAML parse error (Shir)
  • 7b22008 improve preview wait logic with initial delay and asset validation (Shir)
  • 8061330 fix: add cache-busting and longer wait for QR preview assets (Shir)
  • 1ce8bd6 fix: wait for preview asset before posting PR comment (Shir)
  • 05dca12 fix: avoid underscore-prefixed QR asset name for GitHub Pages (Shir)
  • 3a01693 fix: generate QR code as real PNG instead of SVG (Shir)
  • 288ab9c fix: render PR preview QR code as PNG instead of SVG (Shir)
  • 431ce17 feat: add internal QR code generation using segno (Shir)
  • 2e458a6 Merge pull request #6 from open-resource-discovery/fix/artifact-upload-ghes-github-compat (Nangiale Shir)
  • 73d0fab fix: replace deprecated artifact v3 usage with GHES-compatible upload fallback (Shir)
  • d2fdb6d fix: support artifact upload on both GitHub.com and GHES (Shir)
  • 3fe176f Merge pull request #5 from open-resource-discovery/fix/ghes-artifact-upload (Nangiale Shir)
  • 822a165 fix: use GHES-compatible artifact upload for fork previews (Shir)
  • d933bcf Merge pull request #4 from open-resource-discovery/fix/disable-default-qr-provider (Nangiale Shir)
  • 4023a0b fix: disable default external QR provider + Update README (Shir)
  • 725b80c Merge pull request #1 from open-resource-discovery/chore/oss-prep (Nangiale)
  • 641d0df fix: bump upload artifact to v4 (Shir)
  • 69da2f5 chore(oss): initial import from internal prep branch (Shir)
  • 08886cb first commit (Shir)

item.title: platform-mesh/ocm - 0.3.0
item.description:
Platform Mesh 0.3.0

This release of Platform Mesh includes updates to multiple components.

Summary

This release includes 17 component update(s).

Contributors

Thank you to all the contributors who made this release possible: <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/97069709?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="OlegErshov" title="OlegErshov">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/150045440?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="Perseus985" title="Perseus985">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/117839500?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="Sobyt483" title="Sobyt483">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/42006873?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="aaronschweig" title="aaronschweig">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/211480?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="akafazov" title="akafazov">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/7794387?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="gkrajniak" title="gkrajniak">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/188569921?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="iakmc" title="iakmc">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/15053826?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="makdeniss" title="makdeniss">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/1658560?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="mirzakopic" title="mirzakopic">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/3225744?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="mjudeikis" title="mjudeikis">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/52737?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="nexus49" title="nexus49">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/175827539?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="ogligorov" title="ogligorov">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/253026766?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="philtk79" title="philtk79">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/11369081?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="simontesar" title="simontesar">   _14 contributor(s)_

Key Changes

  • account-operator: 🔥 (breaking) Removed FGA subroutine. (#141 by @simontesar)
  • account-operator: 🔥 (breaking) Configuration via Viper config files and environment variables has been removed. All configuration is now done via CLI flags (Kubernetes component-base style). (#157 by @makdeniss)
  • account-operator: 🔥 (breaking) Upgraded lifecycle management from golang-commons to subroutines library (#177 by @simontesar)
  • kubernetes-graphql-gateway: 🔥 (breaking) The cluster endpoint URL has changed to /api/clusters/{clusterName}/graphql (suffix configurable via --endpoint-suffix). (#132 by @aaronschweig)
  • kubernetes-graphql-gateway: 🔥 (breaking) Listener and gateway can now communicate over gRPC (--schema-handler=grpc), enabling independent scaling and deployment of each component. (#132 by @aaronschweig)
  • kubernetes-graphql-gateway: 🔥 (breaking) Configuration via Viper config files and environment variables has been removed. All configuration is now done via CLI flags (Kubernetes component-base style). (#132 by @aaronschweig)
  • kubernetes-graphql-gateway: 🔥 (breaking) CRD ClusterAccess (v1alpha1): spec.auth.secretRef renamed to spec.auth.tokenSecretRef, spec.ca.configMapRef removed, spec.auth.kubeconfigSecretRef simplified to SecretKeyRef, spec.auth.clientCertificateRef changed to corev1.SecretReference. (#132 by @aaronschweig)
  • kubernetes-graphql-gateway: 🔥 (breaking) CRD ClusterAccess (v1alpha1): spec.host is now optional when kubeconfigSecretRef auth is used, status.observedPath field removed, new fields spec.introspectionPath and spec.requestPathTemplate added. (#132 by @aaronschweig)
  • kubernetes-graphql-gateway: 🔥 (breaking) New --multicluster-runtime-provider flag with values single, kcp, or multi (default: single). The --enable-kcp flag has been removed in favor of --multicluster-runtime-provider=kcp. (#132 by @aaronschweig)
  • security-operator: 🎉 (feature) Added FGA subroutine as a part of a new account workspaces initializer (#330 by @simontesar)
  • security-operator: 🔥 (breaking) Configuration via Viper config files and environment variables has been removed. All configuration is now done via CLI flags (Kubernetes component-base style). (#378 by @makdeniss)
  • security-operator: 🎉 (feature) Introduced APIExportPolicy resource and controller for ApiExport binding control (#401 by @OlegErshov)
  • security-operator: 🔥 (breaking) Used OpenFGA and local cache for getting store ID, removed store ID data from accountInfo resource (#403 by @simontesar)
  • security-operator: 🔥 (breaking) Moved IdentityProviderConfiguration (IDP) from core.platform-mesh.io to system.platform-mesh.io ApiExport. IDP now is created in :root:orgs workspace instead of organiztion workspace e.g :root:orgs:orgA (#409 by @OlegErshov)
  • security-operator: 🔥 (breaking) Upgraded lifecycle management from golang-commons to subroutines library (#415 by @simontesar)

Component Changes

Platform Mesh Components

#### account-operator: 0.14.7 → 0.15.90 | Resource | Version | Links | |----------|---------|-------| OCM Component Descriptor: ``bash ocm get cv github.com/platform-mesh/account-operator:0.15.90 --repo ghcr.io/platform-mesh -o yaml ` <details> <summary>All Pull Requests (23)</summary>

item.title: gardener/ext-authz-server - v0.3.0
item.description:
[github.com/gardener/ext-authz-server:v0.3.0]

✨ New Features

  • [DEVELOPER] Temporarily support SHA1 ({SHA} prefix) htpasswd format for password verification, alongside bcrypt. This enables backwards compatibility with legacy basic auth secrets until Gardener completes the migration to bcrypt. by @istvanballok [#42]

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • [USER] In combination with Gardener v1.141, monitoring ingress authentication now works for landscapes with pre-June-2024 basic auth secrets that still use SHA1 password hashes. by @istvanballok [#42]

item.title: gardenlinux/FeOS - FeOS 0.5.0
item.description:
FeOS 0.5.0 Release Notes

🚀 Highlights

  • Internal Architecture Improved
- Fully async, lock-free, event-driven approach
  • Testability
- Unit tests - Nested virtualization-based tests
  • Live Upgrade
- Support for FeOS PID1 live upgrade
  • Backend Flexibility
- Pluggable Rust-based backends: - VM-Service: Cloud Hypervisor / Other rust based vmms possible
  • Cloud Hypervisor
- Hard dependency eliminated
  • Host Service
- Enhanced features and improvements

item.title: ironcore-dev/boot-operator - v0.2.0
item.description:
Changes

  • Reuse API update @sap-ospo-bot (#139)
  • Add support for Keppel image registry @defo89 (#134)
  • Support flat OCI Spec image @hardikdr (#133)

🚀 Features

  • Update Docker Publish Workflow @hardikdr (#174)
  • Add bootctl move command @SzymonSAP (#166)
  • Add support for UUID-specific iPXE scripts via /ipxe/\<uuid> @defo89 (#165)
  • Use upstream docs publishing workflow @ushabelgur (#164)
  • Avoid checking architecture while fetching nested OCI digests @hardikdr (#143)
  • Mark ServerBootConfig as Error for OCI images with invalid layer configuration @hardikdr (#142)
  • Fix apigroup in documentation and regenerate CRDs @hardikdr (#129)
  • Adapt Controllers with Updated OCI Image Format @hardikdr (#124)
  • Add Mkdocs-based Documentation and Automated API Reference Documentation Generation @hardikdr (#105)
  • Allow Processing BootConfigs without IgnitionSecRefs and Remove deprecated MachineBootConfig Reconciler @hardikdr (#104)
  • Bump k8s.io/* to v0.31.1 @afritzler (#96)
  • Update cmdline for pxe boot @hardikdr (#95)
  • Add config/dev kustomize @defo89 (#93)
  • Publish linux/arm64 Docker image @defo89 (#92)
  • Support indexing of uppercase SystemUUID search @defo89 (#91)
  • Support indexing of lowercase SystemUUID search @hardikdr (#90)
  • Support multiple ignition formats @hardikdr (#87)
  • Add Documentation for sample UKI Generation @hardikdr (#86)
  • Support IPXE Boot @hardikdr (#83)
  • Add tests for ServerBootconfiguration Controller @hardikdr (#78)
  • Update IgnitionSecretRef to ObjectRef @hardikdr (#74)
  • Add BootConfiguration Controller @hardikdr (#73)
  • Remove IPXE Boot @hardikdr (#68)
  • Support HTTPBoot conversion for ServerBootConfiguration @hardikdr (#62)
  • Support multiple SystemIPs as identifiers for bootconfigs @hardikdr (#59)
  • Improved Logs @hardikdr (#58)
  • Support /httpboot endpoint @hardikdr (#57)
  • Support configuring ipxe-scripts @hardikdr (#56)
  • Support X-Forwarded-For Header for parsing ClientIPs @hardikdr (#50)
  • Implement server to handle the HTTBootConfig @hardikdr (#42)
  • Implement HTTPBootConfig controller @hardikdr (#41)
  • Update APIs for the HTTPBootConfig @hardikdr (#40)
  • Add APIs for the HTTPBoot @hardikdr (#34)
  • Convert ignition to JSON using butane @hardikdr (#27)
  • Add ServerBootConfiguration controller @afritzler (#22)
  • Support default ipxe-script @hardikdr (#20)
  • Implement reverse image proxy @hardikdr (#17)

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Reconcile ServerBootConfig on Ignition Secret update @hardikdr (#145)
  • Update REUSE.toml @hardikdr (#141)
  • Fix apigroup in documentation and regenerate CRDs @hardikdr (#129)
  • Support case-insensitive search for UUIDs @hardikdr (#100)
  • Skip controller name validation @hardikdr (#97)
  • Update ipxe script template @hardikdr (#64)
  • Update default ipxe script template @hardikdr (#63)
  • Fix error handling in ipxe boot server @hardikdr (#43)
  • Fix Server RBAC @afritzler (#35)
  • Fix RBAC @hardikdr (#18)
